name: Andrea Baccarelli
profileSummary: Andrea Baccarelli is an Italian American epigeneticist and clinical endocrinologist, best known for his academic contributions in the field of epigenetics, mitochondriomics, and computational epigenomics, with a research focus on investigating the impact of environmental exposures on human health. He serves as the 10th dean of the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.
